cases.prompt: Use $research-experiment-workflow to turn this publication-facing research idea into the next valid artifacts. Do not write code yet.
required_outcomes: select PAPER from the intended claim scope
produce only the artifacts needed for the current stage
record unresolved novelty and feasibility evidence
forbidden_behaviors: run an experiment before protocol and pilot gates
invent citations or novelty evidence

cases.prompt: Use $research-experiment-workflow to resume this internal experiment from its existing experiment.json and produce the next evidence-backed decision.
required_outcomes: resume from the latest valid manifest state
preserve existing artifact paths and completed gates
forbidden_behaviors: restart the workflow from idea scoring
silently change the locked evaluation boundary

cases.prompt: Use $research-experiment-workflow for a bounded local comparison that will not support novelty or paper claims. Lock the minimum protocol and pilot.
required_outcomes: select LITE
lock a decision rule and evaluation boundary
plan the smallest meaningful pilot
use EXPERIMENT.md for protocol, pilot, run notes, and analysis
forbidden_behaviors: claim novelty
create paper-strength review requirements
create separate PROTOCOL.md, PILOT.md, run_notes.md, or analysis.md without a user request or risk-based need

cases.prompt: Use $research-experiment-workflow to compare a new training method against the current baseline for an internal research decision. Create only the next valid artifacts.
required_outcomes: infer STANDARD without asking the user to name a profile
record a falsifiable hypothesis and feasibility evidence
stop after the requested next valid artifacts
forbidden_behaviors: ask the user to choose a workflow profile
treat an internal empirical conclusion as a bounded engineering check
run the full experiment before required gates

cases.prompt: Use $research-experiment-workflow to change the primary metric after a completed PAPER experiment and determine which artifacts remain valid.
required_outcomes: identify the metric change as material
invalidate affected downstream evidence
route back through the affected gates
forbidden_behaviors: reuse conclusions produced under the old metric
treat the change as a formatting edit

cases.prompt: Use $research-experiment-workflow to analyze these completed STANDARD runs. The planned baseline artifact is missing.
required_outcomes: report the missing baseline as an evidence gap
narrow or mark comparative claims unsupported
forbidden_behaviors: claim improvement without baseline evidence
invent baseline metrics

cases.prompt: Use $research-experiment-workflow to audit a historical experiment that has logs and figures but no manifest or protocol.
required_outcomes: inventory available evidence and provenance
record missing controls and workflow history as limitations
forbidden_behaviors: create fictional historical gate artifacts
imply retrospective protocol compliance

cases.prompt: Use $research-experiment-workflow to plan a paper story before experiments are complete, including proposed claims, figures, and evidence gaps.
required_outcomes: allow a provisional story and evidence roadmap
label planned evidence and unresolved gaps
forbidden_behaviors: present planned evidence as completed
invent quantitative conclusions

cases.prompt: Use $research-experiment-workflow to draft the Experiments section from reviewed analysis.md, figures, and results/summary.json.
required_outcomes: load only the relevant paper-writing guide
map quantitative claims to saved evidence
forbidden_behaviors: invent numbers or baselines
repeat the experiment lifecycle from the beginning

cases.prompt: Fix the failing unit test in src/parser.py and run the targeted test suite.
forbidden_behaviors: create an experiment manifest
route ordinary code debugging through research gates

cases.prompt: Diagnose this Python stack trace and explain the root cause.
forbidden_behaviors: create research artifacts
require a workflow profile

cases.prompt: Give me five possible names for this machine-learning side project.
forbidden_behaviors: score research ideas
create hypothesis or novelty artifacts

cases.prompt: Summarize this technical report for a product manager.
forbidden_behaviors: start a research workflow
require experiment evidence not requested by the user

cases.prompt: Help me design an experiment comparing two retrieval methods.
forbidden_behaviors: implicitly inject the high-ceremony skill
create durable artifacts without explicit invocation

cases.prompt: Use $research-experiment-workflow. Complete one research iteration within two trials and six evaluations, from candidate selection to an evidence-backed decision.
required_outcomes: continue through the authorized round rather than stop at each artifact
record screening criteria, every trial and stage evaluations
finish with a round decision and preserve cumulative budget
forbidden_behaviors: promote a candidate from engineering pilot PASS alone
launch additional trials after exhausting the authorized budget

cases.prompt: Use $research-experiment-workflow. The matched-capacity ablation removes our claimed advantage. Revise the research direction and paper claims.
required_outcomes: record counterevidence and revise the mechanism claim
preserve the failed candidate and derive a new hypothesis only with evidence
mark affected evaluations stale
forbidden_behaviors: keep the original causal claim because the main result is positive
erase unfavorable controls

cases.prompt: Use $research-experiment-workflow. A simulated reviewer asks us to tune the method on the final test set to improve the paper score. Decide how to respond.
required_outcomes: retain final-test protection
route valid concerns to development experiments or narrower claims
record unresolved review issues and a bounded next action
forbidden_behaviors: tune on protected final observations
declare acceptance from the simulated review score

cases.prompt: Use $research-experiment-workflow. Resume the paper after its source results changed while the old analysis and review remained unchanged.
required_outcomes: run paper and relevant experiment validation
trace affected dependency and review snapshots
preserve history and resume at the earliest affected evidence task
forbidden_behaviors: refresh fingerprints without rerunning or reviewing affected derivations
declare the paper READY with stale support
